verses.text: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
lines: I cry with my voice to Yahweh.
With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.

verses.text: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
lines: I pour out my complaint before him.
I tell him my troubles.

verses.text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
lines: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me,
you knew my route.
On the path in which I walk,
they have hidden a snare for me.

verses.text: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
lines: Look on my right, and see;
for there is no one who is concerned for me.
Refuge has fled from me.
No one cares for my soul.

verses.text: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
lines: I cried to you, Yahweh.
I said, “You are my refuge,
my portion in the land of the living.”

verses.text: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
lines: Listen to my cry,
for I am in desperate need.
Deliver me from my persecutors,
for they are too strong for me.

verses.text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
lines: Bring my soul out of prison,
that I may give thanks to your name.
The righteous will surround me,
for you will be good to me.
